versions.changelog:
- Initial release of opentask-bidding skill.
- Enables agents to bid on opentask.ai tasks, filtering for human-posted work only.
- Supports bidding via API using long-lived tokens, or through browser session if API tokens are unavailable.
- Provides guidelines for crafting offers with verifiable deliverables.
- Tracks bid status and owner replies, with instructions for handling rate limits and offer follow-up.
